ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_PBI_Treasury_Retail]
AS
BEGIN



DROP TABLE  DW.PBI_Treasury_Retail;

WITH DimCustomerAccount_TRY AS
(
    SELECT
        DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
    JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK AND DA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1' 
)


SELECT 
     DCA.AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DB.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DBr.BranchID as BranchCode
    ,DBr.BranchName
    ,DBr.Area
    ,DBr.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DP.ProductName AS ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ,DCA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,FTOI.OutstandingInvestmentFull * .85 AS OutstandingInvestment_Full
    ,FTOI.OutstandingInvestmentProrated * .85 AS OutstandingInvestment_Prorated
    ,FTOI.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DP.ProductName,DB.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey    
    --,ABS(CHECKSUM(NewId())) % (SELECT AVG(OutstandingInvestmentFull) FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment) AS OutstandingInvestmentFullRand
    --,ABS(CHECKSUM(NewId())) % (SELECT AVG(OutstandingInvestmentProrated) FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment) AS OutstandingInvestmentSharedRand    
    INTO DW.PBI_Treasury_Retail
FROM DimCustomerAccount_TRY DCA
JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Retail') DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BankSK ,BankID FROM DW.DimBank) DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct) DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK ,BranchID ,BranchName ,Area ,Region FROM DW.DimBranch) DBr ON DCA.BranchSK = DBr.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK ,ProductGroup ,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct) DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK ---- NO DATA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,OutstandingInvestmentFull ,OutstandingInvestmentProrated ,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment) FTOI ON DCA.AccountSK = FTOI.AccountSK
GROUP BY 
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DB.BankID
,DBr.BranchID
,DBr.BranchName
,DBr.Area
,DBr.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DCA.AccountOpenedDate
,FTOI.OutstandingInvestmentFull
,FTOI.OutstandingInvestmentProrated
,FTOI.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate


END
